llm_response.reason: The website presents itself as an official Aubade® boutique but operates under a domain (inesbeyer.shop) not associated with the Aubade brand (whose authentic site is aubade.com). This matches scam website characteristic #16 (impersonation of legitimate brand names and logos). The site also lacks transparent company information, providing generic privacy and payment statements, which match scam characteristics #4 and #7. The combination of brand impersonation and lack of legitimacy checks strongly indicates a Fake Online Shopping scam.
